findings.current: His mother’s piercing scream as she resisted the soldiers trying to violate her to protect her only surviving child, his Master’s final words—those memories were so vivid.
findings.defect: “Trying to violate her” makes the soldiers’ completed abuse an attempt and makes her resistance sound like it succeeded.
findings.rationale: 유린당한 describes what the soldiers did to her, not merely what they tried to do. “Brutalized” preserves the source’s restraint without changing the event.
findings.replacement: His mother’s piercing scream as the soldiers brutalized her while she fought to protect her only surviving child, and his Master’s final words—those memories were so vivid.
findings.source: 유일하게 남은 자식을 지키기 위해 저항하다 병사들에게 유린당한 어머니의 찢어지는 비명은

findings.current: There wasn’t a single person who hadn’t taken shelter beneath his vast shadow, and there wasn’t a place Dark Heaven’s hand hadn’t reached.
findings.defect: The second clause changes Dark Heaven’s reach from people to places, obscuring the network of people established by both clauses.
findings.rationale: Both clauses end in 자, referring to people; the following account describes officials spreading throughout the land.
findings.replacement: There wasn’t a single person who hadn’t taken shelter beneath his vast shadow, and not one of them was beyond Dark Heaven’s reach.
findings.source: 그의 넓은 그늘에 잠시 몸을 의탁하지 않은 자가 없고, 암천의 손이 닿지 않은 자가 없다.

findings.current: “Mom’s smack hits your soul. Not your body.”
findings.defect: “Smack” drops the mock martial-arts technique name that delivers the joke.
findings.rationale: 엄마신장 casts his mother’s blow as a named palm technique; the contrast with a bodily blow is the punchline.
findings.replacement: “Mom’s Divine Palm hits your soul. Not your body.”

findings.current: Just as the curtain falling on a performance didn’t mean the curtain call was over.
findings.defect: The draft implies a curtain call already underway rather than one still to come.
findings.rationale: 남아 있듯이 says the curtain call remains after the curtain falls, paralleling the roles that remain after the battle.
findings.replacement: Just as a curtain call still follows when the curtain falls on a performance.
findings.source: 공연의 막이 내려도 커튼콜(Curtain call)이 남아 있듯이.

findings.current: Past dozens of flags rising high into the air.
findings.defect: The draft turns looking at the flags into physically passing them.
findings.rationale: 바라보며 specifies an act of looking, not a route past the flags.
findings.replacement: Looking toward the dozens of flags rising high into the air.
findings.source: 높게 솟아오른 수십여 개의 깃발을 바라보며.

findings.current: My Master was usually a kind man, but sometimes he’d take up the switch.
findings.defect: “Man” and “he” assign a gender the passage does not specify.
findings.rationale: 스승님 and 분 identify the teacher respectfully without establishing gender.
findings.replacement: My Master was usually gentle, too, but sometimes the switch would come out.
findings.source: 스승님도 평소에는 온화하신 분이었지만 종종 회초리를 드시곤 했어.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it changes a completed assault into an attempted one, shifts Dark Heaven’s reach from people to places, and loses a martial-arts joke.
